description: The headless slider core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createSlider is the runes state machine behind SvSlider: it owns the value to position math, stepping, keyboard and drag state, and exposes trackProps and thumbProps. The core never touches the DOM; the renderer measures the track and passes the rect in. One core drives the styled SvSlider and a custom draggable bar, both bound to a single number.

faq.question: Why does the renderer pass the rect in?
faq.answer: Converting a pointer position to a value needs the track's size and offset, and measuring is a DOM concern. The renderer measures with getBoundingClientRect and hands the rect to the core, which stays pure and testable.

faq.question: How is dragging handled?
faq.answer: thumbProps wires pointer down and the core tracks the drag through pointer move and up, converting positions to stepped values; the render just reads the value.

faq.question: Does the custom bar get the keyboard?
faq.answer: Yes. thumbProps includes the slider role, aria-valuenow and the arrow, Home, End and Page key handling.
